# template_example_item (Data Source)

Reads an example item from the template client. Replace this with a real API-backed data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "template_example_item" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Example item name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Example item description.
- `endpoint` (String) Endpoint configured for the template client.
- `id` (String) Stable identifier derived from the item name.
